transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Learn a generative formula by seeing both its stable roles and several varied instantiations.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Abstract procedure followed by repeated worked examples.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Define a small number of stable placeholders once, preserve their visual role in every example, and make the final wording/output visibly different from the input tokens.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use when a real, bounded formula can generate several meaningfully different cases. Do not imply that a reusable copy formula guarantees reach or performance.
